confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant, café and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, because July is Marbella's peak season and hotel and hostel rates vary widely by date and property. Cocktail and wine are estimated from general knowledge of Spanish resort pricing, not a beer-based ratio. The FX observation (0.6955, 2026-10-15) comes from a search summary that cites the RBA exchange-rates overview page; I did not open that page directly, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Costa del Sol resort pricing, using Málaga and nearby coastal resorts such as Estepona and Fuengirola as reference points, adjusted upward for Marbella's premium resort character and July high-season demand.
